issue.title: Enhancement: test_cont_link_flap is flaky due to using a sleep to wait for memory stable

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the enhancement

The test should wait intelligently until memory stable instead of arbitrary 30 seconds

### Current Behavior

The test does this:
`        # Wait 30s for the memory usage to be stable`
but on topos with more routes this is inelegant and can be flaky.

### Proposed Behavior

use wait_until to verify memory stability, allow more time on T2 topos.

resolution.title: test_cont_link_flap wait until memory stable instead of sleep, with extended time for T2
resolution.description:
### Description of PR

Summary:
Fixes #27007

Make `platform_tests/link_flap/test_cont_link_flap.py` more consistent on T2 testbeds.

The test previously waited 30s arbitrarily. Use wait_until instead with an upper max wait time of 60s for T2, this pattern is used earlier in the test as well.

Note that if "stability" is not reached within the wait until, the test still proceeds to the final check.
